delta_v_mean_v.description: Mean voltage drop across the cable assembly under test.
delta_v_mean_v.physical_meaning: Primary indicator of total series path impedance.

delta_v_median_v.description: Median voltage drop across the cable assembly.
delta_v_median_v.physical_meaning: Robust central tendency resistant to transient measurement spikes.

delta_v_std_v.physical_meaning: Measures voltage fluctuations caused by mechanical flex or contact flutter.

delta_v_iqr_v.physical_meaning: Robust measure of voltage dispersion unaffected by extreme outlier glitches.

delta_v_mad_v.description: Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) of voltage drop.
delta_v_mad_v.physical_meaning: Scale-invariant robust spread metric for non-Gaussian noise.

r_loop_slope_ohms.formula: Slope R from linear fit: delta_v = offset + R * current (settled intervals only)
r_loop_slope_ohms.description: Effective multi-load loop resistance from settled measurements.
r_loop_slope_ohms.physical_meaning: True dynamic DC loop resistance independent of contact zero-offsets.
r_loop_slope_ohms.validity_condition: Computed ONLY when distinct settled current levels >= 2.

v_offset_fit_v.formula: Intercept of linear fit: delta_v = offset + R * current
v_offset_fit_v.physical_meaning: Characterizes thermoelectric EMF or ADC instrumentation bias.

has_multiload_fit.description: Flag indicating if multi-load slope resistance could be legitimately computed.
has_multiload_fit.physical_meaning: Guarantees scientific integrity by preventing single-load slope estimation.

r_point_mean_ohms.formula: mean(delta_v / current) on settled samples where current > 0.05A
r_point_mean_ohms.description: Single-point apparent resistance calculated during settled intervals.
r_point_mean_ohms.physical_meaning: Fallback resistance metric when multi-load sweep is not performed.

fit_rmse_v.description: Root Mean Squared Error of the multi-load linear resistance fit.
fit_rmse_v.physical_meaning: Quantifies deviation from ideal Ohmic behavior (e.g. non-linear contact resistance).

fit_r2.description: Coefficient of determination of the linear V-I fit.

fit_max_residual_v.description: Maximum individual sample deviation from the multi-load linear fit.
fit_max_residual_v.physical_meaning: Identifies localized non-linear spikes or thermal jumps.

current_mean_a.description: Average current flowing through the cable during steady-state testing.

current_std_a.description: Current standard deviation during settled intervals.
current_std_a.physical_meaning: Measures power supply and electronic load current regulation stability.

current_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of the current signal.

settled_current_stability.formula: fraction of settled samples within +/- 2.5% of commanded load setpoint
settled_current_stability.physical_meaning: Verifies that the electronic load reached steady-state regulation.

distinct_current_levels_count.formula: count of distinct settled load clusters separated by at least 0.2A
distinct_current_levels_count.description: Number of distinct current setpoint plateaus observed in the trial.
distinct_current_levels_count.physical_meaning: Prerequisite condition for multi-load resistance slope extraction.

settled_sample_ratio.description: Fraction of trial duration spent in settled electrical steady state.
settled_sample_ratio.physical_meaning: Separates dynamic switching transitions from steady-state measurements.

missing_sample_count.description: Total number of missing or dropped telemetry packets.

missing_sample_ratio.description: Proportion of dropped frames relative to nominal expected sample count.

quality_ok_ratio.description: Fraction of samples with sensor health confirmed as OK.

temp_mean_c.physical_meaning: Thermal context for resistance normalization (copper tempco is ~0.393%/°C).

temp_drift_c.description: Temperature excursion observed across the trial duration.

has_valid_temperature.description: Indicates whether valid thermal telemetry was present.

fast_capture_source_present.formula: Explicit hardware registration flag for sub-microsecond comparator / fast ADC
fast_capture_source_present.description: Flag indicating if a dedicated fast-sampling hardware channel was active.
fast_capture_source_present.physical_meaning: SCIENTIFIC RIGOR: The INA226 cannot capture microsecond interrupts. Set to False for INA226.

fast_interruption_count.formula: NaN if not fast_capture_source_present else count(fast micro-interrupts)
fast_interruption_count.description: Number of validated fast electrical interruptions (< 100 us).
fast_interruption_count.physical_meaning: Transient event counts are NEVER fabricated from slow INA226 channels.

r_loop_calibrated_ohms.description: Effective loop resistance corrected for characterized test fixture tare resistance.
r_loop_calibrated_ohms.physical_meaning: Isolated cable resistance (fixture tare subtracted; reference cable NOT assumed to be 0 Ω).

r_point_calibrated_ohms.description: Point resistance corrected for characterized fixture tare resistance.
